title: External Validation of a Widely Implemented Proprietary Sepsis Prediction Model in Hospitalized Patients
supports_claim: External validation of the Epic Sepsis Model across 38455 hospitalizations reported an AUC of 0.63, sensitivity of 33 percent, positive predictive value of 12 percent, alerts on 18 percent of hospitalized patients, and 1709 of 2552 sepsis patients not identified.
limitations: Single academic health system and a retrospective cohort; it measures the model version in use at the time and does not measure how clinicians responded to the alerts.

title: Careless Whisper Speech-to-Text Hallucination Harms
publisher: ACM Conference on Fairness Accountability and Transparency
supports_claim: Roughly 1 percent of Whisper audio transcriptions contained entire hallucinated phrases absent from the audio, 38 percent of those hallucinations included explicit harms, and hallucinations occurred disproportionately for speakers with longer non-vocal durations such as people with aphasia.
limitations: Evaluates a general speech-to-text service on an aphasia speech corpus as of 2023, not a deployed clinical documentation product, so medical harm is foreseeable rather than measured.

title: NEDA Suspends AI Chatbot for Giving Harmful Eating Disorder Advice
supports_claim: The Tessa chatbot was suspended after recommending 1 to 2 pounds of weekly weight loss, calorie counting and caliper body-fat measurement to eating-disorder help seekers, on a helpline that had fielded nearly 70000 calls the previous year.
limitations: News report with no stated publication date; a designer said the bot was not as sophisticated as a large generative model, so this may be scripted-content and governance failure rather than an LLM failure.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam's Artificial Intelligence Law 134/2025/QH15 was passed on 2025-12-10 and took effect on 2026-03-01.
limitations: The published page carries document metadata and a signed PDF attachment; it does not display the risk classification articles, so obligations must be read from the full text.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg issuing the list of high-risk artificial intelligence systems
supports_claim: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg issues Vietnam's list of high-risk AI systems, was signed on 2026-06-30 and took effect on 2026-08-15.
limitations: The page confirms that a high-risk list exists but shows only an attached signed PDF, so it cannot by itself confirm whether a ward deterioration assistant is listed.

title: Regulatory framework for AI
supports_claim: The Commission sets out four AI Act risk tiers and a staged timeline in which general applicability began on 2026-08-02, high-risk systems in sensitive areas must comply by 2027-12-02 and high-risk systems embedded in regulated products by 2028-08-02.
limitations: The overview page does not name healthcare or patient triage explicitly and carries no publication date, so it cannot settle which route a clinical assistant falls under.

title: Law 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025/QH15 was passed on 2025-06-26 and took effect on 2026-01-01.
limitations: The page shows metadata and a signed PDF only, so the sensitive-data definition and the health-data duties must be confirmed from the full text by counsel.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST organises voluntary AI risk management around the Govern Map Measure and Manage functions used here to structure controls and monitoring.
limitations: Voluntary framework; it is not a legal classification, a certification, or evidence that any specific control works.

title: Non-Profit Helpline Shifts To Chatbots Then Shuts Down Rogue AI
supports_claim: Forbes independently confirms NEDA CEO Liz Thompson's statement that the Tessa chatbot may have given harmful information, that the bot was rule-based rather than a large generative model, and that NEDA laid off 6 paid staff and over 200 volunteers from a helpline that served nearly 70000 people the prior year.
limitations: Reports the same NEDA statement and numbers as other press coverage rather than an independent audit of the chatbot's outputs, and does not state which calendar year the 70000 prior-year calls occurred in.
